40009892.author: पदार्थः
40009892.content: सहलक्ष्मणः accompanied by Lakshmana, समानशोकः equally sad, चैव also, काकुत्स्थ Kakutstha (Rama), सुग्रीवं Sugriva, साङ्गदम् along with Angada, तारां च and Tara, सान्त्वयन् pacifying, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

40009892.author: Translation
40009892.content: Rama and Lakshmana were equally sad. Rama, scion of the Kakutstha race, consoled Sugriva, Tara as well as Angada in the following words:

40009893.author: पदार्थः
40009893.content: शोकपरितापेन by lamenting, मृतः the dead, श्रेयसा with wellbeing, न युज्यते will not gain, अत्र here, यत् whatever, अनन्तरम् later, कार्यम् should be done, तत् that, समाधातुम् to take up, अर्हथ you may do.

40009893.author: Translation
40009893.content: 'No lamentation revives the dead. So you should take up whatever is required now.

40009894.author: पदार्थः
40009894.content: लोकवृत्तम् worldly way, अनुष्ठेयम् should be performed, वः by you, बाष्पमोक्षणम् shedding tears, कृतम् is done, कालात्  after lapse of time, उत्तरम् later, परम् supreme, किञ्चित् कर्म even a little task, उपासितुम् to be engaged in, न शक्यम् not possible.

40009894.author: Translation
40009894.content: 'You have to go the worldly way. You have shed tears enough. Time is passing. You cannot perform the funeral after the lapse of appropriate time.

40009895.author: पदार्थः
40009895.content: लोके  the worlds, नियतिः fate, कारणम् cause, नियतिः fate, कर्मसाधनम् to accomplish tasks, इह here, सर्वभूतानाम् for all beings, नियोगेषु  to assign respective duties, नियतिः fate, कारणम् is the cause.

40009895.author: Translation
40009895.content: 'Fate is the cause of the world. Fate is the means of accomplishment. Fate assigns duties to all beings.

40009896.author: पदार्थः
40009896.content: कस्यचित् for any one, नियोगे in controlling, कश्चित् any one, कर्ता agent of action, न not even, ईश्वरः अपि च Iswara also, न not, लोकः world, स्वभावे by nature, वर्तते follows, तस्य for that, कालः only time, परायणम् ultimate cause.

40009896.author: Translation
40009896.content: 'No one can control another's action. No one including God can be the agent of action. No one has the power to entrust duty to others. This entire world is governed by one's own nature. Nature in turn is governed by Time (fate).

40009897.author: पदार्थः
40009897.content: कालः Iswara, कालम् time, न अत्येति not deviate, कालः fate, न परिहीयते is not subjected any concession, कश्चित् anybody, स्वभावम् one's own nature, समासाद्य after exercising, न अतिवर्तते cannot transgress.

40009897.author: Translation
40009897.content: 'God (though independent) does not deviate from Time. Time cannot be escaped or trangressed. It cannot be condoned or avoided. No one can transgress their own nature.

40009898.author: पदार्थः
40009898.content: कालस्य Time, बन्धुत्वम् relationship, नास्ति is not there, आत्मनो वशः self itself, हेतुः reason, न no, पराक्रमः valour, न not, मित्रज्ञातिसम्बन्धः relationship based on friendship, कारणम् cause, न no.

40009898.author: Translation
40009898.content: 'Time has no consideration for relationship, friendship, or kinship or valour. Time itself is the cause. It is never under one's control.

40009899.author: पदार्थः
40009899.content: किं तु however, साधु properly, पश्यता by a person who can see, कालपरीणामः effect of fate, द्रष्टव्यः should be visualised, धर्मश्च and dharma, अर्थश्च even wealth, कामश्च and pleasures, कालक्रमसमाहिताः are ordained by an order which is controlled by fate.

40009899.author: Translation
40009899.content: 'However a wise man should visualise the turn of events in course of time with the right vision. Dharma, artha and kama are controlled by an order laid down by Time.

40009900.author: पदार्थः
40009900.content: प्लवगेश्वरः king of monkeys, वाली vali, इतः dead, स्वाम् his own, प्रकृतिम् nature, गतः has reached, धर्मार्थकामसंयोगैः with the combination of dharma, wealth and pleasures, पवित्रम् sacred, क्रियाफलम् result of his action, प्राप्तः attained.

40009900.author: Translation
40009900.content: 'Vali, king of monkeys is dead and gone. He acted according to his own nature and attained the sacred fruit of his action comensurate with dharma, wealth and pleasures in this world.

40009901.author: पदार्थः
40009901.content: प्राणान् life, अपरिरक्षिता by not protecting, तेन महात्मना by that great soul, स्वधर्मस्य सम्योगात् by virtue of his own dharma, स्वर्गः heaven, जितः won, परिगृहीतश्च has been accepted.

40009901.author: Translation
40009901.content: 'Great Vali has earned a place in heaven by virtue of his own dharma and not caring for his own life .He has got the heavenly position he earned.

40009902.author: पदार्थः
40009902.content: हरियूथपः chief of monkeys, याम् whichever, गतः has gone, एषा this, नियतिः destiny, श्रेष्ठा वै is the very best, तत् therefore, परितापेन to regret, अलम् no need of, प्राप्तकालम् at this time, उपास्यताम् attend.

40009902.author: Translation
40009902.content: 'The state attained by the chief of monkeys is an excellent one.Therefore there is no need to regret. Attend to your duties (relating to rites)'

40009903.author: पदार्थः
40009903.content: रामस्य Rama's, वचनान्ते at the end of his address, परवीरहा slayer of enemy warriors, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, गतचेतसम् he who had lost his senses, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, प्रश्रितम् humbly, वाक्यम् these words, अवदत् said.

40009903.author: Translation
40009903.content: Seeing Sugriva had lost his senses, Lakshmana, the slayer of enemy warriors humbly said at the end of Rama's address:

40009904.author: पदार्थः
40009904.content: सुग्रीव O Sugriva, त्वम् you, ताराङ्गदाभ्याम् with Tara and Angada, सहितः along with, अस्य his, अनन्तरम् later, प्रेतकार्यम् funeral rites, कुरु you may do, वालिनः for Vali, दहनं प्रति for the cremation.

40009904.author: Translation
40009904.content: 'O Sugriva perform with Tara and Angada the funeral obsequies relating to the cremation of Vali.

40009905.author: पदार्थः
40009905.content: शुष्कानि dried, बहूनि many, काष्ठानि logs of wood, दिव्यानि best one, चन्दनादीनि च sandalwood and such things, वालिसंस्कार कारणात् for the funeral rites of Vali, समाज्ञापय  order.

40009905.author: Translation
40009905.content: 'Let the best of dry logs and sandalwood be ordered for the funeral rites of Vali.

40009906.author: पदार्थः
40009906.content: त्वम् you, दीनचेतसम् despondent, एनम् him, अङ्गदम् Angada, समाश्वासय you may pacify, त्वम् you, बालिशबुद्धिः मा भूः you may not be childish, इदं पुरम् this city, त्वदधीनम् is under you.

40009906.author: Translation
40009906.content: 'Pacify the despondent Angada so that he does not entertain childish thoughts any more. This city is under your control (now).

40009907.author: पदार्थः
40009907.content: अङ्गदस्तु Angada for his part, माल्यम् garlands, विविधानि of many kinds, वस्त्राणि च clothes, घृतम् clarified butter, तैलम् oil, अथो now, गन्धानि fragrants, अत्र here, यत् whatever, समनन्तरम् is required to be collected, आनयेत् let him get.

40009907.author: Translation
40009907.content: 'Let Angada for his part collect garlands of many kinds, clothes, clarified butter, oil, fragrants and all that is required to be procured.

40009908.author: पदार्थः
40009908.content: तार Tara (a monkey), त्वम् you, सम्भ्रमात् hasten, शीघ्रम् quickly, शिबिकाम् litter, आदाय after getting, आगच्छ may come, त्वरा swiftly, गुणवती tied with ropes, विशेषतः specially, अस्मिन्काले at this time, युक्ता हि will be proper.

40009908.author: Translation
40009908.content: 'O Tara quickly get a swiftmoving litter fastened with ropes specially  suitable for this occasion.

40009909.author: पदार्थः
40009909.content: शिबिकावाहनोचिताः those monkeys who can carry the litter, समर्थाः capable ones, बलिनश्चैव and strong also, प्लवगाः monkeys, सज्जीभवन्तु let them get ready, वालिनम् Vali's, निर्हरिष्यन्ति they will carry him.

40009909.author: Translation
40009909.content: 'Let those who are strong and capable among the monkeys be ready to carry  the dead body of Vali on a litter'.

40009910.author: पदार्थः
40009910.content: सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः the delight of Sumitra, परवीरहा slayer of enemies, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, भ्रातृसमीपस्थः near his brother, स्थौ stood.

40009910.author: Translation
40009910.content: Having thus spoken to Sugriva, Lakshmana, son of Sumitra, slayer of enemies, stood by his brother

40009911.author: पदार्थः
40009911.content: तारः Tara, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, सम्भ्रान्तमानसः with exited mind, शिबिकासक्तमानसः entrusted to get a latter, शीघ्रम्  quickly, गुहाम् cave, प्रविवेश entered.

40009911.author: Translation
40009911.content: On hearing Lakshmana, Tara in an excited state quickly entered the cave city to get the litter.

40009912.author: पदार्थः
40009912.content: सः तारः that Tara, उद्वहनोचितैः by those who can carry, शूरैः by heroes, वानरैः by monkeys, उह्यमानाम् being carried, ताम् that, शिबिकाम् litter, आदाय after getting, पुनःagain, पर्यापतत् jumped in.

40009912.author: Translation
40009912.content: Tara jumped in on to the litter carried by strong monkeys.

40009913.author: पदार्थः
40009913.content: दिव्याम् marvellous, भद्रासनयुताम् with a splendid seat, स्यन्दनोपमाम् comparable to a chariot, पक्षिकर्मभिः with different forms of birds, आचित्राम् carved, द्रुमकर्मविभूषिताम् decorated with the designs of trees, चित्रपत्तीभिः with colourful pictures, आचिताम् covered with, समन्ततः on every side, सुनिविष्टाम् perfectly fixed, सिद्धानाम् of saints, विमानमिव like aerialchariot, जालवातायनायुताम् with grilled windows, सुनियुक्ताम् fitted, विशालां च also big, सुकृताम् wellcarved, विश्वकर्मणा by Visvakarma, दारुपर्वतकोपेताम् decorated with wooden mountains, चारुकर्मपरिष्कृताम् embelished beautifully, वराभरणहारैश्च decorated with choicest ornaments, चित्रमाल्योपशोभिताम् decorated with beautiful garlands, गुहागहनसञ्छन्नाम्  with artificially created caverns and grottos, रक्तचन्दनभूषिताम् furbished with red sandal paste, पुष्पौघैः with heaps of flowers, तरुणादित्यवर्णाभिः resembling the colour of the rising Sun, भ्राजमानाभिः with radiant ones, पद्ममालाभिःwith lotus garlands, आवृताम् covered, शिबिकाम् palanquin

40009913.author: Translation
40009913.content: A swiftmoving, marvellous palanquin designed by Viswakarma was brought. Covered with colourful pictures of birds and trees on every side it looking like an aerial chariot fit for saints. Fitted with a splendid seat grilled windows, artificially made small caverns and grottos of wood was embellished with carvings of mountains, choice ornaments and garlands. With red sandal paste, red scented flowers and red lotus garlands, it resembled the rising Sun.

40009914.author: पदार्थः
40009914.content: दिव्याम् marvellous, भद्रासनयुताम् with a splendid seat, स्यन्दनोपमाम् comparable to a chariot, पक्षिकर्मभिः with different forms of birds, आचित्राम् carved, द्रुमकर्मविभूषिताम् decorated with the designs of trees, चित्रपत्तीभिः with colourful pictures, आचिताम् covered with, समन्ततः on every side, सुनिविष्टाम् perfectly fixed, सिद्धानाम् of saints, विमानमिव like aerialchariot, जालवातायनायुताम् with grilled windows, सुनियुक्ताम् fitted, विशालां च also big, सुकृताम् wellcarved, विश्वकर्मणा by Visvakarma, दारुपर्वतकोपेताम् decorated with wooden mountains, चारुकर्मपरिष्कृताम् embelished beautifully, वराभरणहारैश्च decorated with choicest ornaments, चित्रमाल्योपशोभिताम् decorated with beautiful garlands, गुहागहनसञ्छन्नाम्  with artificially created caverns and grottos, रक्तचन्दनभूषिताम् furbished with red sandal paste, पुष्पौघैः with heaps of flowers, तरुणादित्यवर्णाभिः resembling the colour of the rising Sun, भ्राजमानाभिः with radiant ones, पद्ममालाभिःwith lotus garlands, आवृताम् covered, शिबिकाम् palanquin

40009914.content: A swiftmoving, marvellous palanquin designed by Viswakarma was brought. 40009915.content: A swiftmoving, marvellous palanquin designed by Viswakarma was brought. Covered with colourful pictures of birds and trees on every side it looking like an aerial chariot fit for saints. 40009916.content: दिव्याम् marvellous, भद्रासनयुताम् with a splendid seat, स्यन्दनोपमाम् comparable to a chariot, पक्षिकर्मभिः with different forms of birds, आचित्राम् carved, द्रुमकर्मविभूषिताम् decorated with the designs of trees, चित्रपत्तीभिः with colourful pictures, आचिताम् covered with, समन्ततः on every side, सुनिविष्टाम् perfectly fixed, सिद्धानाम् of saints, विमानमिव like aerialchariot, जालवातायनायुताम् with grilled windows, सुनियुक्ताम् fitted, विशालां च also big, सुकृताम् wellcarved, विश्वकर्मणा by Visvakarma, दारुपर्वतकोपेताम् decorated with wooden mountains, चारुकर्मपरिष्कृताम् embelished beautifully, वराभरणहारैश्च decorated with choicest ornaments, चित्रमाल्योपशोभिताम् decorated with beautiful garlands, गुहागहनसञ्छन्नाम्  with artificially created caverns and grottos, रक्तचन्दनभूषिताम् furbished with red sandal paste, पुष्पौघैः with heaps of flowers, तरुणादित्यवर्णाभिः resembling the colour of the rising Sun, भ्राजमानाभिः with radiant ones, पद्ममालाभिःwith lotus garlands, आवृताम् covered, शिबिकाम् palanquin

40009916.author: Translation
40009916.content: A swiftmoving, marvellous palanquin designed by Viswakarma was brought. Covered with colourful pictures of birds and trees on every side it looking like an aerial chariot fit for saints. Fitted with a splendid seat grilled windows, artificially made small caverns and grottos of wood was embellished with carvings of mountains, choice ornaments and garlands. With red sandal paste, red scented flowers and red lotus garlands, it resembled the rising Sun.

40009917.author: पदार्थः
40009917.content: ईदृशीम् such, शिबिकाम् palanquin, दृष्ट्वा seeing, रामः Rama, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् said, वाली Vali, क्षिप्रम् quickly, विनीयताम् carried, प्रेतकार्यम् last rites, विधीयताम् be performed.

40009917.author: Translation
40009917.content: Seeing the palanquin, Rama said to Lakshmana 'Let the body of Vali be placed in the palanquin quickly and last rites duly performed'.

40009918.author: पदार्थः
40009918.content: ततः then, अङ्गदेन सहैव तु along with Angada , सुग्रीवःSugriva, विक्रोशन् while crying aloud, वालिनम् Vali, उद्यम्य after lifting, तदा then, शिबिकाम् palanquin, आरोपयत  placed him on it

40009918.author: Translation
40009918.content: Then Sugriva along with Angada, crying aloud bitterly, lifted the body (of Vali) and placed it on the palanquin.

40009919.author: पदार्थः
40009919.content: विविधैः with different, अलङ्कारैश्च with ornaments, माल्यैः with garlands, वस्त्रैश्च clothes, भूषितम्  adorned, गतजीवितम् dead, वालिनम् Vali, शिबिकाम् palanquin, आरोप्य on placing.

40009919.author: Translation
40009919.content: Vali's deadbody was placed on the palanquin, decorated with many ornaments, garlands and clothes

40009920.author: पदार्थः
40009920.content: तदा then, राजा the king, प्लवगेश्वरः king of monkeys, सुग्रीव Sugriva, आज्ञापयत् instructed,  अनुरूपतः in a fitting manner, और्ध्वदैहिक funeral rites, आर्यस्य for the noble sire, क्रियतां may be conducted

40009920.author: Translation
40009920.content: King Sugriva, lord of the monkeys, said, 'Let the funeral rites of my noble sire be performed in a fitting manner'.

40009921.author: पदार्थः
40009921.content: प्लवगाः monkeys, विविधानि different, बहूनि many, रत्नानि gems, विश्राणयन्तः showering, अग्रतः   in front, यान्तु let them go, शिबिका palanquin, समनन्तरम् be followed.

40009921.author: Translation
40009921.content: 'Let the monkeys march in front, showering many different gems in large quantities and let the palanquin follow.

40009922.author: पदार्थः
40009922.content: भुवि earth, राज्ञाम् for kings, यादृशाः such, ऋद्धिविशेषाः special kinds of wealth, दृश्यन्ते seen, तादृशैः with such, वानराः monkeys, भर्तृसत्क्रियाम् the last rites to the revered leader, डह here, कुर्वन्तु may be done.

40009922.author: Translation
40009922.content: 'Let the monkeys perform the funeral rites of our lord in an honourable way as expensively as has been done with regard to the obsequies of kings who ruled over this land.

40009923.author: पदार्थः
40009923.content: वालिनः Vali, तादृशम् such, और्द्वदैहिकम् funeral rites, क्षिप्रम् quickly, प्राकुर्वन् did, तदा then, हतबान्धवाः (whose) relative (Vali) was dead, तारप्रभृतयः Tara and others, सर्वे all, वानराः monkeys, अङ्गदम् Angada, परिगृह्या taking with, क्रोशन्तः  were crying aloud, आशु fast, प्रयमुः walked.

40009923.author: Translation
40009923.content: Tara, Angada and the other bereaved monkeys hastened to perform the funeral ceremony of Valiweeping.

40009924.author: पदार्थः
40009924.content: ततः then, अस्य his, वशानुगाः those who were under his control, सर्वाः all, वानर्यः female monkeys, प्रणिहिताः stretched forth, वीर a great hero, इति saying so, चुक्रुशुः cried, ताः those, स्त्रियः women, भूयः again, क्रोशन्ति were bewailing.

40009924.author: Translation
40009924.content: Then all the female monkeys who were in his (Vali's) harem walked past the deadbody of Vali, crying again and again 'Alas, Oh hero'

40009925.author: पदार्थः
40009925.content: हरियूथपाः chief of the monkey troops, ताराप्रभृतयः Tara and others, सर्वाः all, वानर्यः  female monkeys, करुणस्वनाः with pathetically, क्रोशन्त्यः crying, भर्तारम् husband, अनुजग्मुः went following, हि indeed.

40009925.author: Translation
40009925.content: Tara along with other female monkeys followed their lord, crying pathetically.

40009926.author: पदार्थः
40009926.content: वनान्तरे in the midst of the forest, तासाम् of them, वानरीणाम् of female monkeys, रुदितशब्देन by their cries, सर्वतः all over, वनानि forest, गिरयश्चैव and the mountains, विक्रोशन्तीव looked as if they were mourning.

40009926.author: Translation
40009926.content: When the female monkeys were weeping in the midst of the forest, it looked as if the forest and the hills were also mourning.

40009927.author: पदार्थः
40009927.content: शोककर्शिताः agonzied, सुबहवः many, वानराः monkeys, गिरिनद्याः of a mountain stream, जलसंवृते surrounded by flow of water, विविक्ते in a solitary place, पुलिने on the sand bank, चिताम् a pyre, चक्रुः prepared.

40009927.author: Translation
40009927.content: Tormented with tears, the monkeys prepared in a solitary place surrounded by waters a pyre on the sandbank of a mountain stream.

40009928.author: पदार्थः
40009928.content: ततः then, सर्वे all, वाहनोचिताः the carriers of the palanquin, स्कन्धात् from their shoulders, शिबिकाम् palanquin, अवरोप्य brought down, शोकसमन्विताः filled with sorrow, एकान्तम् solitary place, आश्रित्य resorting to, तस्थुः stood.

40009928.author: Translation
40009928.content: Putting down the palanquin from their shoulders on the lonely spot, the bearers stood in tearswaiting.

40009929.author: पदार्थः
40009929.content: ततः then, तारा Tara, शिबिकातलशायिनम् who was lying on the sibika, पतिम् husband, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, सुदुःखिता a lady full of grief, तस्य his, शिरः head, अङ्के on her lap, आरोप्य  placed, विललाप cried.

40009929.author: Translation
40009929.content: Seeing her husband lying in the palanquin, Tara, full of grief placed Vali's head on her lap and cried.

40009930.author: पदार्थः
40009930.content: हा वानरमहाराज O monkey king, हा मम नाथ O my great husband, हा महार्ह O venerable lord, हा महाबाहो O longarmed one, मम my, प्रिय dear, माम् me, पश्य see, त्वम् you, शोकाभिपीडितम् tormented with tears, इमं जनम् this person, कस्मात् why, न पश्यसि not see?

40009930.author: Translation
40009930.content: 'Why don't you look at me, oppressed with tears, O monkey king, O my venerable lord, O longarmed one, O my dear?

40009931.author: पदार्थः
40009931.content: हा वानरमहाराज O monkey king, हा मम नाथ O my great husband, हा महार्ह O venerable lord, हा महाबाहो O longarmed one, मम my, प्रिय dear, माम् me, पश्य see, त्वम् you, शोकाभिपीडितम् tormented with tears, इमं जनम् this person, कस्मात् why, न पश्यसि not see?

40009931.author: Translation
40009931.content: 'Why don't you look at me, oppressed with tears, O monkey king, O my venerable lord, O longarmed one, O my dear?

40009932.author: पदार्थः
40009932.content: मानद revered self, गतासोरपि even though you are bereft of life, ते your, अस्तार्कसमवर्णम् bears the colour of the setting Sun, वक्त्रम् face, जीवतो यथा the same colour when you were alive, इह here, प्रहृष्टम् happy, दृश्यते appears.

40009932.author: Translation
40009932.content: 'O revered self even though you are bereft of life, your face looks cheerful. It carries the colour of the setting Sun, and looks the same when you were alive.

40009933.author: पदार्थः
40009933.content: वानर monkey, एषः कालः this god of death, त्वाम् you, रामरूपेण in the form of Rama, कर्षति dragged away, येन by that, वने in the forest, एकेषुणा with a single arrow, सर्वाः all, विधवाः widows, कृताः are turned.

40009933.author: Translation
40009933.content: 'O monkey a single arrow from Rama who appeared in the forest in the form of death dragged you away from us and turned us all into widows.

40009934.author: पदार्थः
40009934.content: राजेन्द्र O king of kings, तव your, ताः those, वानर्यः female monkeys, वल्लभाः wives who were dear to you, पादैः on foot, तव your, विकृष्टम् long, अध्वानम् path, आगताः have come, किम् why, न बुध्यसे do you not know.

40009934.author: Translation
40009934.content: 'O king of kings why don't you understand that these female monkeys, your wives who were dear to you have come on foot this long distance with great difficulty?

40009935.author: पदार्थः
40009935.content: प्लवगेश्वरम् lord of monkeys, इमाः these, चन्द्रनिभाननाः moonfaced women, भार्याः wives, तव you, इष्टाः ननु your favourite ones indeed, इदानीम् now, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, कस्मात् why, न वेक्षसे  not seeing.

40009935.author: Translation
40009935.content: 'O lord of monkeys these moonfaced wives were indeed once your favourites. Why don't you look  at them? Why don't you look Sugriva?

40009936.author: पदार्थः
40009936.content: राजन् O king, तारप्रभृतयः Tara and others, एते these, तव सचिवाः your ministers, अयम् this, पुरवासिजनः inhabitants of the capital, परिवार्य by surrounding you, आसते they are sitting, अनघ O sinless hero.

40009936.author: Translation
40009936.content: 'O king O sinless hero Tara and others, your ministers as well as the inhabitants of the capital are here sitting around you.

40009937.author: पदार्थः
40009937.content: अरिन्दम O conqueror of enemies, एतान् all of them, प्लवगान् monkeys, यथोचितं in accordance with their position, विसर्जय send them, ततः then, मदनोत्कटाः in a passionate way, सर्वाः all of us, वनेषु in the forest, क्रीडामहे will be sporting.

40009937.author: Translation
40009937.content: 'O conqueror of enemies give these monkeys their due in accordance with their status and send them back as you used to do when they were passionately sporting in your company here in this forest.

40009938.author: पदार्थः
40009938.content: एवम् in that way, विलपतीम् mourning, पतिशोकपरिप्लुताम् overwhelmed with sorrow due to the death of the husband, ताराम् Tara, तदा then, शोककर्शिताः those overtaken by grief, वानर्यः female monkeys, उत्थापयन्ति स्म helped her to stand up.

40009938.author: Translation
40009938.content: The griefstricken female monkeys helped Tara, overwhelmed with sorrow due to her husband's death, rise from the ground.

40009939.author: पदार्थः
40009939.content: ततः then, सः अङ्गदः that Angada, सुग्रीवेण सार्धम् along with Sugriva, रुदन् crying, शोकेन in sorrow, अभिहतेन्द्रियः with his senses numbed, पितरम् father, चिताम् on the pyre, आरोपयामास placed.

40009939.author: Translation
40009939.content: Then Angada, helped by Sugriva, placed his father's body on the pyre, with his senses numbed in deep sorrow.

40009940.author: पदार्थः
40009940.content: ततः then, सः he, व्याकुलेन्द्रियः with disturbed senses, विधिवत् as per tradition, अग्निम् fire, दत्वा offering, दीर्घम् long distance, अध्वानम् way, प्रस्थितम् departing, पितरम् to father, अपसव्यं चकार went round once in an anteclock manner.

40009940.author: Translation
40009940.content: Overwhelmed with sorrow, he offered fire to the father who had set out on a long journey (to heaven). As per tradition he went round the pyre anteclock wise.

40009941.author: पदार्थः
40009941.content: प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, तं वालिनम् that Vali, विधिवत् as per tradition, संस्कृत्य after allowing it to be consumed by fire, उदकं कर्तुम् made waterofferings, शुभजलाम् a place of pure water, शिवाम् auspicious, नदीम् river, आजग्मुः reached.

40009941.author: Translation
40009941.content: The monkeys set Vali's body to be consumed by fire as per tradition and proceeded to an auspicious river of pure water in order to offer oblation (to the departed soul).

40009942.author: पदार्थः
40009942.content: ततः then, सुग्रीवतारासहिताः along with Sugriva and Tara, ते वानराः those monkeys, तत्र there, सहिताः collectively, अङ्गदम् Angada, अग्रतः in front, स्थाप्य by placing, जलम् water, सिषिचुः they offered.

40009942.author: Translation
40009942.content: Then the monkeys along with Sugriva and Tara positioning Angada in the forefront made waterofferings (to Vali) collectively.

40009943.author: पदार्थः
40009943.content: महाबलः mighty, काकुत्स्थ: Kakutstha, दीनेन by the piteous, सुग्रीवेण with Sugriva, इव as though, समानशोकः equally sad, दीनः pitiable one, भूत्वा was equally, प्रेतकार्याणि funeral rites, अकारयत् directed.

40009943.author: Translation
40009943.content: Mighty Rama, who was equally sorrowful and pitiable as Sugriva, directed the performance of funeral rites.
